svg.title: Crack runner: Pixel art
svg.desc: Crack runner (2D): Mossa, in her long red scarf, leaps from ledge to ledge up a crack in the bark, carrying a reading between cities. Sap drips from above, a mite walks the next ledge, a lichen tuft waits to bounce her higher, and a sheet of dust is falling after a tremor. The strip at the top shows her mark on the route and the tremor due ahead; the brace marker is lit.
